summary: Practise budget credibility, cash forecasting, IFMIS controls and fiscal reporting. Explore this five-day public finance course.
lede: Public financial management training helps budget officers, public accountants and treasury staff link approved allocations to reliable spending records and reports. You will practise budget variance analysis, cash forecasting, commitment tracking, transaction coding and reconciliation, with guided foundation-level coverage of PEFA, GFS 2014 and IPSAS concepts rather than implementation training.
audienceIntro: This course suits you if your work touches public budgets, payment processing, fiscal records or the explanation of spending results. It is designed for people who need a practical foundation in how public finance administration connects budget decisions with transactions and reports.
prerequisites: No prior public financial management course is required. Basic familiarity with budgets, financial records or administrative workflows will help you apply the exercises; coding or programming is not required.
